mapper.sql: select blackout_id, room_id, room_code, start_time, end_time, reason, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from space_blackout
mapper.select: where room_id = #{roomId} and status = '0' and start_time < str_to_date( concat( #{bookingDate}, ' ', case when char_length(#{endTime}) = 4 then concat('0', #{endTime}, ':00') when char_length(#{endTime}) = 5 then concat(#{endTime}, ':00') when char_length(#{endTime}) = 7 then concat('0', #{endTime}) else #{endTime} end ), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) and end_time > str_to_date( concat( #{bookingDate}, ' ', case when char_length(#{startTime}) = 4 then concat('0', #{startTime}, ':00') when char_length(#{startTime}) = 5 then concat(#{startTime}, ':00') when char_length(#{startTime}) = 7 then concat('0', #{startTime}) else #{startTime} end ), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) order by start_time asc, blackout_id asc

select sri.item_id, sri.reservation_id, sri.room_id, sri.room_code, sri.room_name, coalesce(srt.type_name, srm.room_type) as room_type, sri.booking_date, sri.weekday, sri.start_time, sri.end_time, sri.item_status, sri.conflict_flag, sri.conflict_reason, sri.conflict_item_id, sri.audit_time, sri.auditor_id, sri.auditor_name, sri.reject_reason, sri.create_by, sri.create_time, sri.update_by, sri.update_time, sri.remark, sr.reservation_no, sr.reservation_type, sr.title, sr.people_count, sr.applicant_name, sr.org_name, sr.detail_remark, sr.status as reservation_status, sr.audit_type from space_reservation_item sri left join space_reservation sr on sr.reservation_id = sri.reservation_id left join space_room srm on srm.room_id = sri.room_id left join space_room_type srt on srt.type_id = srm.type_id where sri.room_id = #{roomId} and sri.item_status in ('1', '2', '4') and sr.del_flag = '0' and str_to_date( concat( sri.booking_date, ' ', case when char_length(sri.start_time) = 4 then concat('0', sri.start_time, ':00') when char_length(sri.start_time) = 5 then concat(sri.start_time, ':00') when char_length(sri.start_time) = 7 then concat('0', sri.start_time) else sri.start_time end ), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) < #{endTime} and str_to_date( concat( sri.booking_date, ' ', case when char_length(sri.end_time) = 4 then concat('0', sri.end_time, ':00') when char_length(sri.end_time) = 5 then concat(sri.end_time, ':00') when char_length(sri.end_time) = 7 then concat('0', sri.end_time) else sri.end_time end ), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) > #{startTime} order by sri.booking_date asc, sri.start_time asc, sri.item_id asc
